art.silhouette: A great disc-bodied ray with an enormous central solar-eye at the front face, surrounded by radiating fin-rays like a living sun diagram. The body is deep gold with white-hot veins. The fin-rays are translucent amber, trailing fading light halos at their tips. The eye is an intense white-core disc. Even at idle, the battle background behind it yellows. The silhouette at 64px is a sun — because it is one.
